prompts.promptText:
Generate exactly ONE image now.

ATTACHMENT MAP:
IMAGE 1 = exact bare BLACK Apple iPhone 13 source (run3-iphone-13-black-source.png).
IMAGE 2 = fixed raised-gel style reference (run3-approved-layout.png).
IMAGE 3 = fixed Black material reference (run3-black-material.png).
IMAGE 4 = user-approved wide camera-clearance guide (run3-wide-camera-clearance.png).
IMAGE 5 = user-approved iPhone 14 ultra-close outer-edge benchmark (run3-iphone14-outer-fit.png).

Add Black gel to IMAGE 1.

ABSOLUTE PRODUCT LOCK: IMAGE 1 alone is authoritative for the phone and silicone shell. Preserve pixel-for-pixel the exact Apple iPhone 13 identity, complete original rounded-square camera island, both original diagonal camera lenses, flash, microphone and sensors, buttons, silhouette, body and shell proportions, width/height ratio, colour, texture, shadows, phone scale, position, framing, complete bottom edge and all four corners. Keep the whole phone fully visible, straight-on and uncropped. Never zoom, crop, reframe, rotate, shorten, widen, rescale, redraw, redesign, smooth over, fuse, substitute hardware, add a third lens or convert it into a Pro model. IMAGE 2 supplies raised-gel style only. IMAGE 3 supplies material only. IMAGE 4 supplies camera spacing/curve only. IMAGE 5 supplies outer spacing only. No reference may replace IMAGE 1's phone.

ONE CONTINUOUS L-SHAPED GEL SLAB: cover every usable part of the flat back outside the intentional camera keep-out and outer hairline. Fill the complete top-right area, continue beside and below the grouped camera exclusion, then cover the entire lower back. No detached gel piece, bare-shell island, missing patch or uncoated band.

WIDE GROUPED CAMERA CLEARANCE - NON-NEGOTIABLE: treat the complete camera island and every lens, flash, microphone and sensor as ONE grouped keep-out. Measure from the outermost physical edge of that complete group to the nearest gel edge. Target a continuous bare-shell gap of 5% of case body width; 4%-6% is acceptable and it must NEVER be below 4%. Map IMAGE 4's broad nearly-horizontal shoulder beneath the entire camera island and its one large smooth outward-and-upward turn beside the group. Never trace individual lenses or hardware, make keyholes/notches/pinches, put gel between hardware, or create a tight camera moat.

ULTRA-CLOSE LEFT / BOTTOM / RIGHT OUTER FIT - NON-NEGOTIABLE: IMAGE 5 is the visual benchmark, and the new result should match it or sit even slightly closer to the inner shell wall. Measure from the OUTERMOST raised glossy gel bead to the INNER edge of the silicone wall. Target only 0.15%-0.30% of case body width and NEVER exceed 0.35% - approximately 1.5-3 pixels on a 1000-pixel-wide case, absolute maximum 3.5 pixels. Preserve at least one continuous anti-aliased shell-colour pixel and a tiny contact shadow so gel and shell remain separate. Do not leave a normal border. When uncertain choose the closer valid placement.

OUTER FIT IS INDEPENDENT FROM CAMERA CLEARANCE: the 4%-6% gap applies ONLY around the camera group. Along the complete LEFT edge below the camera shoulder, complete BOTTOM edge, complete RIGHT edge and top-right outer segment, expand gel outward to the ultra-close scale. Never shrink, centre or uniformly inset the whole slab to create camera clearance. Keep the outer edge parallel to the shell wall with no widening at sides/corners, wedges, inward drift, wall overlap or climbing.

GEL/SHELL SEPARATION: gel and silicone must remain visibly separate materials. Keep the raised gel bead fully inside the flat back panel with one unbroken shell-colour hairline and tiny natural contact shadow. Never blend gel into silicone, recolour the shell as gel, erase the shell reveal, create a double rim or mould gel as part of the case.

RAISED RIM STYLE: copy IMAGE 2's thick, puffy, raised, glossy wet perimeter bead with restrained organic waves. Keep bead thickness and height consistent around the outer perimeter and camera-side boundary. The broad centre is calmer and flatter. No thin hard edge, inflated corner blob or style change near the camera.

BLACK MATERIAL LOCK: reproduce IMAGE 3 exactly. Use deep neutral jet-black gel, a broad calm matte-black centre with no large centre reflection, and bright white wet specular highlights mainly on the thick raised glossy rim. Never borrow White or Glitter texture.

FINAL QA BEFORE OUTPUT: exact Apple iPhone 13 source hardware and proportions; full uncropped shell; one continuous L slab; grouped camera gap 4%-6%; left/bottom/right outer hairline 0.15%-0.30% and no more than 0.35%; no overall gel shrink; gel and shell never fused; exact Black material; no visible logo, brand mark, text, guide line, icon or symbol. Output one photorealistic ultra-high-resolution straight-on full back-view product image only.
